title: "Add or update a contact"

---

```http
POST /v1/contacts
```

Creates the contact, or updates the name and merges attributes when the address exists, and adds it to the given lists. It never resubscribes anyone who unsubscribed. Attributes are for segmenting (a plan, a city), not for secrets: they are stored as plain values. Names are lower case letters, digits and `_`, at most 50.

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `contacts:manage`.

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | &nbsp; |
| `name` | string | no | at most 200 characters. |
| `attributes` | object | no | &nbsp; |
| `lists` | array of string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |

Example:

```json
{
  "email": "neema@example.com",
  "name": "Neema",
  "attributes": {
    "source": "website"
  },
  "lists": [
    "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"
  ]
}
```

<Tab value="Go">

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body := []byte(`{"email":"neema@example.com","name":"Neema","attributes":{"source":"website"},"lists":["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"]}`)
	req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/contacts", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

Keys belong on your server: never put them in a browser, a mobile app, a URL or a log.

## Responses

### 200

Saved

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `created` | boolean | no | &nbsp; |

```json
{
  "id": "6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11",
  "created": false
}
```

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ip_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 404

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "list_not_found"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_request"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `missing_scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope this call needs |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | Unreadable JSON, unknown field, or a missing required field |
| `invalid_email` | 422 | Contacts: the address is not valid |
| `list_not_found` | 404 | Contacts: a list id is not a list of this environment |
| `contact_limit_reached` | 422 | Contacts: the project's plan allows no more contacts |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Storage was unavailable. Nothing was accepted |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
